name: Zavijava
description: A naked-eye star 10.9 parsecs away, 1.7 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 102870: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.431 +/- 0.006 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.681 +/- 0.008

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 102870: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.324 +/- 0.005

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 102870: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6132 +/- 26

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 102870: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 91.5 +/- 0.22 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 11 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.7 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.431 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.681 solar radii and 6,132 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 102870: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
